purpose: Curated capability metadata merged into docs/TOOL_INVENTORY.json by Scripts/generate-tool-inventory.mjs. This file is the ONLY hand-maintained input: canonical capability names, migration actions, C++ builder ownership, and live evidence. Everything countable is derived by the generator; do not record counts here.

verification.live_verified: proven against a live UE4.27 editor by the referenced evidence
verification.live_partial: implemented and exercised live, but the recorded evidence is incomplete (see notes)
verification.pending_live: compiled and unit-tested; the live acceptance has not passed yet
verification.mock_only: unit-tested against the mock listener only
verification.untested: no test of any kind on record
verification.compat_verified: proven compatibility adapter over a live_verified canonical target
verification.replaced: legacy HTTP registration whose behavior is fully covered by a native capability or retired

migration_action.KEEP: current implementation remains the supported path for now
migration_action.REFRONT: existing C++ implementation kept; Python/HTTP doorway replaced by the native pipe
migration_action.PORT: no reusable implementation exists; rebuild via the layer named in notes
migration_action.MERGE: narrow tool folded into the stronger canonical capability named in replacement_tool
migration_action.ALIAS: old public name routed to the canonical native tool (compat router)
migration_action.RETIRE: removal proposed; requires evidence, replacement, compatibility coverage, and human sign-off

entry_points: runtime play-test agent module: move, look, press, observe, record, replay

actors.notes: layer: direct_reflection or new_native_wrapper per tool

blueprint-graph.notes: idempotent graph patching is the deferred capability; mutator library is compiled and callable

cpp.notes: belongs to a future build/commandlet backend; legacy lane is the only owner today

effects.notes: layer: direct_reflection for post-process volumes and console effects

intelligence.notes: layer: puerts_workflow; no editor mutation involved

materials.notes: layer: new_native_wrapper; a generic material graph builder is a known gap (sky demo is not one)

optimization.notes: 24-tool profiling suite with no native equivalent; migrate late, by capability group

promptbrush.notes: PromptBrush orchestration; PORT to puerts_workflow when the pipeline migrates

system.notes: transport plumbing for the legacy listener, not a capability; shares one canonical name so it never inflates the unique count

titles.notes: title pipeline; migrate with UMG/sequencer groups

viewport.notes: layer: new_native_wrapper; MCPPuerTSBridgeViewport.cpp already holds the native focus/capture half

blueprint_production_plan.notes: Proven deterministic server-local planner without Unreal Editor.

engine_source_search.notes: no editor involved; unit tests run against the real installed engine source

engine_source_read.notes: no editor involved; unit tests run against the real installed engine source
